title: Area formula on an embedded C¹ submanifold for a C¹ map that is injective with injective derivative (Simon Ch. 2, 4.11–4.13, as used in 5.1–5.2)
statement: Area formula on an embedded C¹ submanifold. Data: P, m ∈ ℕ; M ⊆ ℝ^P; a Borel set E ⊆ ℝ^P; a map Φ : ℝ^P → ℝ^P. Hypotheses: M is an embedded C¹ m-dimensional submanifold of ℝ^P (IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 m M); E is Borel (MeasurableSet E) and E ⊆ M; Φ is C¹ on ℝ^P; Φ is injective on E; the derivative DΦ(x) = fderiv ℝ Φ x is injective for every x ∈ E. Notation: for x ∈ ℝ^P let T_x := span(tangentSpace M x) (a linear subspace, with the inner product of ℝ^P) and ι_x : T_x → ℝ^P the inclusion; J^MΦ(x) := √det((DΦ(x)∘ι_x)*(DΦ(x)∘ι_x)), where * is the adjoint for the inner products of T_x and ℝ^P and det is the determinant of the endomorphism (DΦ(x)∘ι_x)*(DΦ(x)∘ι_x) of T_x. Conclusion: H^m(Φ(E)) = ∫_E J^MΦ dH^m as an equality in [0, ∞], where H^m = μHE[m] and the integrand is read through ENNReal.ofReal (a lower Lebesgue integral ∫⁻ over E).
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (M E : Set (Euclid P)) (Φ : Euclid P → Euclid P), IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 m M → MeasurableSet E → E ⊆ M → ContDiff ℝ 1 Φ → InjOn Φ E → (∀ x ∈ E, Injective (fderiv ℝ Φ x)) → μHE[m] (Φ '' E) = ∫⁻ x in E, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt ((((fderiv ℝ Φ x).comp (Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).subtypeL).adjoint ∘L ((fderiv ℝ Φ x).comp (Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).subtypeL)).det)) ∂μHE[m]
